    signalwire.core.swml_verbs_generated¶

    signalwire.core.swml_verbs_generated ¶

    Typed SWML verb surface, generated from the SWML document schema.

    One <Verb>Config TypedDict per verb plus _SwmlVerbs, which declares each verb method (config -> Self) so type checkers can see the verbs SwmlBuilder installs dynamically at runtime. Static-only: configs are plain dicts at runtime, never validated.

    SWMLMethod = 'Answer | AI | AmazonBedrock | Cond | Connect | Denoise | EnterQueue | Execute | Goto | Label | LiveTranscribe | AiSidecar | LiveTranslate | Hangup | JoinRoom | JoinConference | Play | Prompt | ReceiveFax | Record | RecordCall | Request | Return | SendDigits | SendFax | SendSMS | Set | Sleep | SIPRefer | StopDenoise | StopRecordCall | StopTap | Switch | Tap | Transfer | Unset | Pay | DetectMachine | UserEvent' module-attribute ¶

    SWMLVar = 'str' module-attribute ¶

    CondParams = 'CondReg | CondElse' module-attribute ¶

    TranscribeAction = "TranscribeStartAction | Literal['stop'] | TranscribeSummarizeActionUnion" module-attribute ¶

    TranslateAction = "StartAction | Literal['stop'] | SummarizeActionUnion | InjectAction" module-attribute ¶

    play_url = 'str' module-attribute ¶

    Languages = 'LanguagesWithSoloFillers | LanguagesWithFillers' module-attribute ¶

    AIPostPrompt = 'AIPostPromptText | AIPostPromptPom' module-attribute ¶

    AIPrompt = 'AIPromptText | AIPromptPom' module-attribute ¶

    BedrockPostPrompt = 'OmitPropertiesBedrockPostPomptTextOmittedPromptProps | OmitPropertiesBedrockPostPromptPomOmittedPromptProps' module-attribute ¶

    BedrockPrompt = 'OmitPropertiesBedrockPromptTextOmittedPromptProps | OmitPropertiesBedrockPromptPomOmittedPromptProps' module-attribute ¶

    ValidConfirmMethods = 'Cond | Set | Unset | Hangup | Play | Prompt | Record | RecordCall | StopRecordCall | Tap | StopTap | SendDigits | SendSMS | Denoise | StopDenoise' module-attribute ¶

    CallStatus = "Literal['created', 'ringing', 'answered', 'ended']" module-attribute ¶

    TranscribeSummarizeActionUnion = "TranscribeSummarizeAction | Literal['summarize']" module-attribute ¶

    SummarizeActionUnion = "SummarizeAction | Literal['summarize']" module-attribute ¶

    PayPromptAction = 'PayPromptSayAction | PayPromptPlayAction' module-attribute ¶

    AttentionTimeout = 'int' module-attribute ¶

    Direction = "Literal['inbound', 'outbound']" module-attribute ¶

    SWAIGNativeFunction = "Literal['check_time', 'wait_seconds', 'wait_for_user', 'adjust_response_latency']" module-attribute ¶

    SWAIGFunction = 'UserSWAIGFunction | StartUpHookSWAIGFunction | HangUpHookSWAIGFunction | SummarizeConversationSWAIGFunction' module-attribute ¶

    BedrockSWAIGFunction = 'PickPropertiesUserSWAIGFunctionPickedSWAIGFunctionProps | PickPropertiesStartUpHookSWAIGFunctionPickedSWAIGFunctionProps | PickPropertiesHangUpHookSWAIGFunctionPickedSWAIGFunctionProps | PickPropertiesSummarizeConversationSWAIGFunctionPickedSWAIGFunctionProps' module-attribute ¶

    TranscribeDirection = "Literal['remote-caller', 'local-caller']" module-attribute ¶

    SpeechEngine = "Literal['deepgram', 'google']" module-attribute ¶

    TranslationFilterPreset = "Literal['polite', 'rude', 'professional', 'shakespeare', 'gen-z']" module-attribute ¶

    CustomTranslationFilter = 'str' module-attribute ¶

    TranslateDirection = "Literal['remote-caller', 'local-caller']" module-attribute ¶

    ConversationRole = "Literal['user', 'assistant', 'system']" module-attribute ¶

    POM = 'PomSectionBodyContent | PomSectionBulletsContent' module-attribute ¶

    FunctionFillers = 'dict[str, Any]' module-attribute ¶

    ContextsObject = 'ContextsPOMObject | ContextsTextObject' module-attribute ¶

    SchemaType = 'StringProperty | IntegerProperty | NumberProperty | BooleanProperty | ArrayProperty | ObjectProperty | NullProperty | OneOfProperty | AllOfProperty | AnyOfProperty | ConstProperty' module-attribute ¶

    ContextSteps = 'ContextPOMSteps | ContextTextSteps' module-attribute ¶

    Action = 'SWMLAction | ChangeContextAction | ChangeStepAction | ContextSwitchAction | HangupAction | HoldAction | PlaybackBGAction | SayAction | SetGlobalDataAction | SetMetaDataAction | StopAction | StopPlaybackBGAction | ToggleFunctionsAction | UnsetGlobalDataAction | UnsetMetaDataAction | UserInputAction' module-attribute ¶

    StringFormat = "Literal['date_time', 'time', 'date', 'duration', 'email', 'hostname', 'ipv4', 'ipv6', 'uri', 'uuid']" module-attribute ¶

    Section ¶

    Bases: TypedDict

    Open shape: extra server keys permitted; not validated at runtime.

    main instance-attribute ¶

    Answer ¶

    Bases: TypedDict

    Open shape: extra server keys permitted; not validated at runtime.

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    answer dict[str, Any]

    Answer incoming call and set an optional maximum duration.

    answer instance-attribute ¶

    AI ¶

    Bases: TypedDict

    Open shape: extra server keys permitted; not validated at runtime.

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    ai AIObject

    Creates an AI agent that conducts voice conversations using automatic speech recognition (ASR), large language models (LLMs), and text-to-speech (TTS) synthesis. The agent processes caller speech in real-time, generates contextually appropriate responses, and can execute custom functions to interact with external systems through SignalWire AI Gateway (SWAIG).

    ai instance-attribute ¶

    AmazonBedrock ¶

    Bases: TypedDict

    Open shape: extra server keys permitted; not validated at runtime.

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    amazon_bedrock AmazonBedrockObject

    Creates a new Bedrock AI Agent

    amazon_bedrock instance-attribute ¶

    Cond ¶

    Bases: TypedDict

    Open shape: extra server keys permitted; not validated at runtime.

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    cond list[CondParams]

    Execute a sequence of instructions depending on the value of a JavaScript condition.

    cond instance-attribute ¶

    Connect ¶

    Bases: TypedDict

    Open shape: extra server keys permitted; not validated at runtime.

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    connect ConnectDeviceSingle | ConnectDeviceSerial | ConnectDeviceParallel | ConnectDeviceSerialParallel

    Dial a SIP URI or phone number.

    connect instance-attribute ¶

    Denoise ¶

    Bases: TypedDict

    Open shape: extra server keys permitted; not validated at runtime.

    Attributes:

    AIObject ¶

    Bases: TypedDict

    Open shape: extra server keys permitted; not validated at runtime.

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    global_data dict[str, Any]

    A key-value object for storing data that persists throughout the AI session. Can be set initially in the SWML script or modified during the conversation using the set_global_data action. The global_data object is accessible everywhere in the AI session: prompts, AI parameters, and SWML returned from SWAIG functions. Access properties using template strings (e.g. ${global_data.property_name}).
    hints list[str | Hint]

    Hints help the AI agent understand certain words or phrases better. Words that can commonly be misinterpreted can be added to the hints to help the AI speak more accurately.
    languages list[Languages]

    An array of JSON objects defining supported languages in the conversation.
    params AIParams

    A JSON object containing parameters as key-value pairs.
    post_prompt AIPostPrompt

    The final set of instructions and configuration settings to send to the agent.
    post_prompt_url str

    The URL to which to send status callbacks and reports. Authentication can also be set in the url in the format of username:password@url.
    pronounce list[Pronounce]

    An array of JSON objects to clarify the AI's pronunciation of words or expressions.
    prompt AIPrompt

    Defines the AI agent's personality, goals, behaviors, and instructions for handling conversations. The prompt establishes how the agent should interact with callers, what information it should gather, and how it should respond to various scenarios. It is recommended to write prompts using markdown formatting.
    SWAIG SWAIG

    An array of JSON objects to create user-defined functions/endpoints that can be executed during the dialogue.

    global_data instance-attribute ¶

    ConnectDeviceSingle ¶

    Bases: TypedDict

    Open shape: extra server keys permitted; not validated at runtime.

    Wire-only keys (not valid Python identifiers, so they are listed here rather than as attributes; read them with item access): - from (str): The caller ID to use when dialing the number.

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    headers list[ConnectHeaders]

    Custom SIP headers to add to INVITE. It Has no effect on calls to phone numbers.
    codecs str

    Comma-separated string of codecs to offer. It has no effect on calls to phone numbers. Based on SignalWire settings.
    webrtc_media bool | SWMLVar

    If true, WebRTC media is offered to the SIP endpoint. It has no effect on calls to phone numbers. Default is false.
    session_timeout int | SWMLVar

    Time, in seconds, to set the SIP Session-Expires header in INVITE. Must be a positive, non-zero number. It has no effect on calls to phone numbers. Based on SignalWire settings.
    ringback list[str] | RingbackConfig

    Ringback to play while the far end rings: a legacy array of URIs, or a RingbackConfig object.
    result ConnectSwitch | list[CondParams]

    Action to take based on the result of the call. This will run once the peer leg of the call has ended. Will use the switch method when the return_value is an object, and will use the cond method when the return_value is an array.
    timeout int | SWMLVar

    Time, in seconds, to wait for the call to be answered. Default is 60 seconds.
    max_duration int | SWMLVar

    Maximum duration, in seconds, allowed for the call. Default is 14400 seconds.
    answer_on_bridge bool | SWMLVar

    Delay answer until the B-leg answers. Default is false.
    confirm str | list[ValidConfirmMethods]

    Confirmation to execute when the call is connected. Can be either: - A URL (string) that returns a SWML document - An array of SWML methods to execute inline
    confirm_timeout int | SWMLVar

    The amount of time, in seconds, to wait for the confirm URL to return a response
    username str

    SIP username to use for authentication when dialing a SIP URI. Has no effect on calls to phone numbers.
    password str

    SIP password to use for authentication when dialing a SIP URI. Has no effect on calls to phone numbers.
    encryption Literal['mandatory'] | Literal['optional'] | Literal['forbidden']

    Encryption setting to use. Possible values: mandatory, optional, forbidden
    call_state_url str

    Webhook URL to send call status change notifications to. Authentication can also be set in the URL in the format of username:password@url.
    transfer_after_bridge str | SWMLVar

    SWML to execute after the bridge completes. This defines what should happen after the call is connected and the bridge ends. Can be either: - A URL (http or https) that returns a SWML document - An inline SWML document (as a JSON string)

    Note: This parameter is REQUIRED when connecting to a queue (when to starts with "queue:")
    call_state_events list[CallStatus]

    An array of call state event names to be notified about. Allowed event names are: - created - ringing - answered - ended
    to str

    Destination to dial. Can be: - Phone number in E.164 format (e.g., "+15552345678") - SIP URI (e.g., "sip:alice@example.com") - Call Fabric Resource address (e.g., "/public/test_room") - Queue (e.g., "queue:support")

    Bases: TypedDict

    Attributes:

    name str

    Name of conference
    muted bool | SWMLVar

    Whether to join the conference in a muted state. If set to true, the participant will be muted upon joining. Default false.
    beep Literal['true'] | Literal['false'] | Literal['onEnter'] | Literal['onExit']

    Sets the behavior of the beep sound when joining or leaving the conference. Default "true".
    start_on_enter bool | SWMLVar

    Starts the conference when the main participant joins. This means the start action will not wait on more participants to join before starting. Default true.
    end_on_exit bool | SWMLVar

    Ends the conference when the main participant leaves. This means the end action will not wait on more participants to leave before ending. Default false.
    wait_url str | SWMLVar

    A URL that will play media when the conference is put on hold. Default hold music will be played if not set
    max_participants int | SWMLVar

    The maximum number of participants allowed in the conference. If the limit is reached, new participants will not be able to join. Default 100000.
    record Literal['do-not-record'] | Literal['record-from-start']

    Enables or disables recording of the conference. Default "do-not-record".
    region str

    Specifies the geographical region where the conference will be hosted. Default not set
    trim Literal['trim-silence'] | Literal['do-not-trim']

    If set to trim-silence, it will remove silence from the start of the recording. If set to do-not-trim, it will keep the silence. Default "trim-silence".
    coach str

    Coach accepts a call SID of a call that is currently connected to an in-progress conference. Specifying a call SID that does not exist or is no longer connected will result in a failure.
    status_callback_event Literal['start'] | Literal['end'] | Literal['join'] | Literal['leave'] | Literal['mute'] | Literal['hold'] | Literal['modify'] | Literal['speaker'] | Literal['announcement']

    The events to listen for and send to the status callback URL. Default not set
    status_callback str

    The URL to which status events will be sent. This URL must be publicly accessible and able to handle HTTP requests. Default not set
    status_callback_method Literal['GET'] | Literal['POST']

    The HTTP method to use when sending status events to the status callback URL. Default "POST".
    recording_status_callback str

    The URL to which recording status events will be sent. This URL must be publicly accessible and able to handle HTTP requests. Default not set
    recording_status_callback_method Literal['GET'] | Literal['POST']

    The HTTP method to use when sending recording status events to the recording status callback URL. Default "POST".
    recording_status_callback_event Literal['in-progress'] | Literal['completed'] | Literal['absent']

    The events to listen for and send to the recording status callback URL. Default not set
    result dict[str, Any] | list[CondParams]

    Allows the user to specify a custom action to be executed when the conference result is returned (typically when it has ended). The actions can a switch object or a cond array. The switch object allows for conditional execution based on the result of the conference, while the cond array allows for multiple conditions to be checked in sequence. If neither is provided, the default action will be to end the conference.

    PayPrompts ¶

    Bases: TypedDict

    Open shape: extra server keys permitted; not validated at runtime.

    Wire-only keys (not valid Python identifiers, so they are listed here rather than as attributes; read them with item access): - for (str): The payment step this prompt is for. See Payment Steps for a list of available steps.

    • payment-card-number: Collect the payment card number.
    • expiration-date: Collect the payment card expiration date.
    • security-code: Collect the payment card security code.
    • postal-code: Collect the payment card postal code.
    • payment-processing: The step used during the payment processing.
    • payment-completed: The step used when the payment is completed.
    • payment-failed: The step used when the payment fails.
    • payment-cancelled: The step used when the payment is cancelled.

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    actions list[PayPromptAction]

    Array of action objects to execute for this prompt. These actions can either play an audio file or speak a phrase.
    attempts str

    Specifies which payment attempt(s) this prompt applies to. The value increments when a payment fails. Use a single number (e.g., "1") or space-separated numbers (e.g., "2 3") to target the specific attempts.
    card_type str

    Space-seperated list of card types that are allowed to be used for this prompt.

    Supported card types: - visa - mastercard - amex - maestro - discover - optima - jcb - diners-club
    error_type str

    Space-separated list of error types this prompt applies to.

    Available error types: - timeout - User input timeout - invalid-card-number - Failed card validation - invalid-card-type - Unsupported card type - invalid-date - Invalid expiration date - invalid-security-code - Invalid CVV format - invalid-postal-code - Invalid postal code format - invalid-bank-routing-number - Invalid bank routing number - invalid-bank-account-number - Invalid bank account number - input-matching-failed - Input matching failed - session-in-progress - Concurrent session attempt - card-declined - Payment declined

    actions instance-attribute ¶

    attempts instance-attribute ¶

    card_type instance-attribute ¶

    AIParams ¶

    Bases: TypedDict

    Open shape: extra server keys permitted; not validated at runtime.

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    acknowledge_interruptions bool | SWMLVar

    Instructs the agent to acknowledge crosstalk and confirm user input when the user speaks over the agent.
    ai_model Literal['gpt-4o-mini'] | Literal['gpt-4.1-mini'] | Literal['gpt-4.1-nano'] | str

    The model to use for the AI. Allowed values are gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4.1-mini, and gpt-4.1-nano.
    ai_name str

    Sets the name the AI agent responds to for wake/activation purposes. When using enable_pause, start_paused, or speak_when_spoken_to, the user must say this name to get the agent's attention. The name matching is case-insensitive.
    ai_volume int | SWMLVar

    Adjust the volume of the AI. Allowed values from -50 - 50. Default: 0.
    app_name str

    A custom identifier for the AI application instance. This name is included in webhook payloads, allowing backend systems to identify which AI configuration made the request.
    asr_smart_format bool | SWMLVar

    If true, enables smart formatting in ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition). This improves the formatting of numbers, dates, times, and other entities in the transcript. Default: false
    attention_timeout AttentionTimeout | Literal[0] | SWMLVar

    Amount of time, in ms, to wait before prompting the user to respond. Allowed values from 10,000 - 600,000. Set to 0 to disable. Default: 5000 ms.
    attention_timeout_prompt str

    A custom prompt that is fed into the AI when the attention_timeout is reached.
    asr_diarize bool | SWMLVar

    If true, enables speaker diarization in ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition). This will break up the transcript into chunks, with each chunk containing a unique identity (e.g speaker1, speaker2, etc.) and the text they spoke. Default: false
    asr_speaker_affinity bool | SWMLVar

    If true, will force the AI Agent to only respond to the speaker who reesponds to the AI Agent first. Any other speaker will be ignored. Default: false
    background_file str

    URL of audio file to play in the background while AI plays in foreground.
    background_file_loops int | SWMLVar | None

    Maximum number of times to loop playing the background file. undefined means loop indefinitely.
    background_file_volume int | SWMLVar

    Defines background_file volume within a range of -50 to 50. Default: 0.
    enable_barge str | bool | SWMLVar

    Controls the barge behavior. Allowed values are "complete", "partial", "all", or boolean. Default: "complete,partial"
    enable_inner_dialog bool | SWMLVar

    Enables the inner dialog feature, which runs a separate AI process in the background that analyzes the conversation and provides real-time insights to the main AI agent. This gives the agent a form of "internal thought process" that can help it make better decisions.
    enable_pause bool | SWMLVar

    Enables the pause/resume functionality for the AI agent. When enabled, a pause_conversation function is automatically added that the AI can call when the user says things like "hold on", "wait", or "pause". While paused, the agent stops responding until the user speaks the agent's name (set via ai_name) to resume. Cannot be used together with speak_when_spoken_to.
    enable_turn_detection bool | SWMLVar

    Enables intelligent turn detection that monitors partial speech transcripts for sentence-ending punctuation. When detected, the system can proactively finalize the speech recognition, reducing latency before the AI responds. Works with turn_detection_timeout.
    barge_match_string str

    Takes a string, including a regular expression, defining barge behavior. For example, this param can direct the AI to stop when the word 'hippopotomus' is input.
    barge_min_words int | SWMLVar

    Defines the number of words that must be input before triggering barge behavior, in a range of 1-99.
    barge_functions bool | SWMLVar

    If true, allows functions to be executed while the AI is being interrupted. Default: true.
    conscience str

    Sets the prompt which binds the agent to its purpose.
    convo list[ConversationMessage]

    Injects pre-existing conversation history into the AI session at startup. This allows you to seed the AI agent with context from a previous conversation or provide example interactions.
    conversation_id str

    Used by check_for_input and save_conversation to identify an individual conversation.
    conversation_sliding_window int | SWMLVar

    Sets the size of the sliding window for conversation history. This limits how much conversation history is sent to the AI model.
    debug_webhook_level int | SWMLVar

    Enables debugging to the set URL. Allowed values from 0 - 2. Default is 1 if url is set.
    debug_webhook_url str

    Each interaction between the AI and end user is posted in real time to the established URL.
    debug bool | int | SWMLVar

    Enables debug mode for the AI session. When enabled, additional diagnostic information is logged including turn detection events, speech processing details, and internal state changes.
    direction Direction | SWMLVar

    Forces the direction of the call to the assistant. Valid values are inbound and outbound.
    digit_terminators str

    DTMF digit, as a string, to signal the end of input (ex: '#')
    digit_timeout int | SWMLVar

    Time, in ms, at the end of digit input to detect end of input. Allowed values from 0 - 30,000. Default: 3000 ms.
    end_of_speech_timeout int | SWMLVar

    Amount of silence, in ms, at the end of an utterance to detect end of speech. Allowed values from 250 - 10,000. Default: 700 ms.
    enable_thinking bool | SWMLVar

    Enables thinking output for the AI Agent. When set to true, the AI Agent will be able to utilize thinking capabilities. Important: This may introduce a little bit of latency as the AI will use an additional turn in the conversation to think about the query.
    enable_vision bool | SWMLVar

    Enables visual input processing for the AI Agent. When set to true, the AI Agent will be able to utilize visual processing capabilities, while leveraging the get_visual_input function.
    energy_level float | SWMLVar

    Amount of energy necessary for bot to hear you (in dB). Allowed values from 0.0 - 100.0. Default: 52.0 dB.
    first_word_timeout int | SWMLVar

    Amount of time, in ms, to wait for the first word after speech is detected. Allowed values from 0 - 10,000. Default: 1000 ms.
    function_wait_for_talking bool | SWMLVar

    If true, the AI will wait for any filler to finish playing before executing a function. If false, the AI will execute a function asynchronously as the filler plays. Default: false.
    functions_on_no_response bool | SWMLVar

    If true, functions can be executed when there is no user response after a timeout. Default: false.
    hard_stop_prompt str

    A final prompt that is fed into the AI when the hard_stop_time is reached.
    hard_stop_time str | SWMLVar

    Specifies the maximum duration fopr the AI Agent to remain active before it exists the session. After the timeout, the AI will stop responding, and will proceed with the next SWML instruction.

    Time Format: - Seconds Format: 30s - Minutes Format: 2m - Hours Format: 1h - Combined Format: 1h45m30s
    hold_music str

    A URL for the hold music to play, accepting WAV, mp3, and FreeSWITCH tone_stream.
    hold_on_process bool | SWMLVar

    Enables hold music during SWAIG processing.
    inactivity_timeout int | SWMLVar

    Amount of time, in ms, to wait before exiting the app due to inactivity. Allowed values from 10,000 - 3,600,000. Default: 600000 ms (10 minutes).
    inner_dialog_model Literal['gpt-4o-mini'] | Literal['gpt-4.1-mini'] | Literal['gpt-4.1-nano'] | str

    Specifies the AI model to use for the inner dialog feature. Can be set to a different (often smaller/faster) model than the main conversation model. Only used when enable_inner_dialog is true.
    inner_dialog_prompt str

    The system prompt that guides the inner dialog AI's behavior. This prompt shapes how the background AI analyzes the conversation and what kind of insights it provides to the main agent. Only used when enable_inner_dialog is true.
    inner_dialog_synced bool | SWMLVar

    When enabled, synchronizes the inner dialog with the main conversation flow. This ensures the inner dialog AI waits for the main conversation turn to complete before providing its analysis, rather than running fully asynchronously. Only used when enable_inner_dialog is true.
    initial_sleep_ms int | SWMLVar

    Amount of time, in ms, to wait before starting the conversation. Allowed values from 0 - 300,000.
    input_poll_freq int | SWMLVar

    Check for input function with check_for_input. Example use case: Feeding an inbound SMS to AI on a voice call, eg., for collecting an email address or other complex information. Allowed values from 1000 to 10000 ms. Default: 2000 ms.
    interrupt_on_noise bool | SWMLVar

    When enabled, barges agent upon any sound interruption longer than 1 second.
    interrupt_prompt str

    Provide a prompt for the agent to handle crosstalk.
    languages_enabled bool | SWMLVar

    Allows multilingualism when true. Deprecated.
    local_tz str

    The local timezone setting for the AI. Value should use IANA TZ ID
    llm_diarize_aware bool | SWMLVar

    If true, the AI Agent will be involved with the diarization process. Users can state who they are at the start of the conversation and the AI Agent will be able to correctly identify them when they are speaking later in the conversation. Default: false
    max_emotion int | SWMLVar

    Sets the maximum emotion intensity for the AI voice. Allowed values from 1 - 30. Default: 30.
    max_response_tokens int | SWMLVar

    Sets the maximum number of tokens the AI model can generate in a single response. Lower values produce shorter responses and reduce latency.
    openai_asr_engine str

    The ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) engine to use. Common values include nova-2 and nova-3.
    outbound_attention_timeout int | SWMLVar

    Sets a time duration for the outbound call recipient to respond to the AI agent before timeout, in a range from 10000 to 600000. Default: 120000 ms (2 minutes).
    persist_global_data bool | SWMLVar

    When enabled, the global_data object is automatically saved to a channel variable and restored when a new AI session starts on the same call. This allows data to persist across multiple AI agent invocations within the same call.
    pom_format Literal['markdown'] | Literal['xml']

    Specifies the output format for structured prompts when using the pom array in prompt definitions. Valid values are markdown or xml.
    save_conversation bool | SWMLVar

    Send a summary of the conversation after the call ends. This requires a post_url to be set in the ai parameters and the conversation_id defined below. This eliminates the need for a post_prompt in the ai parameters.
    speech_event_timeout int | SWMLVar

    Amount of time, in ms, to wait for a speech event. Allowed values from 0 - 10,000. Default: 1400 ms.
    speech_gen_quick_stops int | SWMLVar

    Number of quick stops to generate for speech. Allowed values from 0 - 10. Default: 3.
    speech_timeout int | SWMLVar

    Overall speech timeout, in ms. Allowed values from 0 - 600,000. Default: 60000 ms.
    speak_when_spoken_to bool | SWMLVar

    When enabled, the AI agent remains silent until directly addressed by name (using ai_name). This creates a "push-to-talk" style interaction where the agent only responds when explicitly called upon, useful for scenarios where the agent should listen but not interrupt. Cannot be used together with enable_pause.
    start_paused bool | SWMLVar

    When enabled, the AI agent starts in a paused state and will not respond until the user speaks the agent's name (set via ai_name). Automatically enables enable_pause. This is useful for scenarios where you want the agent to wait for explicit activation.
    static_greeting str

    The static greeting to play when the call is answered. This will always play at the beginning of the call.
    static_greeting_no_barge bool | SWMLVar

    If true, the static greeting will not be interrupted by the user if they speak over the greeting. If false, the static greeting can be interrupted by the user if they speak over the greeting.
    summary_mode Literal['string'] | Literal['original'] | SWMLVar

    Defines the mode for summary generation. Allowed values are "string" and "original".
    swaig_allow_settings bool | SWMLVar

    Allows tweaking any of the indicated settings, such as barge_match_string, using the returned SWML from the SWAIG function. Default: true.
    swaig_allow_swml bool | SWMLVar

    Allows your SWAIG to return SWML to be executed. Default: true.
    swaig_post_conversation bool | SWMLVar

    Post entire conversation to any SWAIG call.
    swaig_set_global_data bool | SWMLVar

    Allows SWAIG to set global data that persists across calls. Default: true.
    swaig_post_swml_vars bool | list[str] | SWMLVar

    Controls whether SWML variables are included in SWAIG function webhook payloads. When set to true, all SWML variables are posted. When set to an array of strings, only the specified variable names are included.
    thinking_model Literal['gpt-4o-mini'] | Literal['gpt-4.1-mini'] | Literal['gpt-4.1-nano'] | str

    The model to use for the AI's thinking capabilities. Allowed values are gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4.1-mini, and gpt-4.1-nano.
    transparent_barge bool | SWMLVar

    When enabled, the AI will not respond to the user's input when the user is speaking over the agent. The agent will wait for the user to finish speaking before responding. Additionally, any attempt the LLM makes to barge will be ignored and scraped from the conversation logs. Default: true.
    transparent_barge_max_time int | SWMLVar

    Maximum time, in ms, for transparent barge mode. Allowed values from 0 - 60,000. Default: 3000 ms.
    transfer_summary bool | SWMLVar

    Pass a summary of a conversation from one AI agent to another. For example, transfer a call summary between support agents in two departments.
    turn_detection_timeout int | SWMLVar

    Time in milliseconds to wait after detecting a potential end-of-turn before finalizing speech recognition. A shorter timeout results in faster response times but may cut off the user if they pause mid-sentence. Set to 0 to finalize immediately. Only used when enable_turn_detection is true.
    tts_number_format Literal['international'] | Literal['national']

    The format for the AI agent to reference phone numbers. Allowed values are international and national. Default: international.

    Example: - international: +12345678901 - national: (234) 567-8901
    video_listening_file str

    URL of a video file to play when AI is listening to the user speak. Only works for calls that support video.
    video_idle_file str

    URL of a video file to play when AI is idle. Only works for calls that support video.
    video_talking_file str

    URL of a video file to play when AI is talking. Only works for calls that support video.
    vision_model Literal['gpt-4o-mini'] | Literal['gpt-4.1-mini'] | Literal['gpt-4.1-nano'] | str

    The model to use for the AI's vision capabilities. Allowed values are gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4.1-mini, and gpt-4.1-nano.
    vad_config str

    Configures Silero Voice Activity Detection (VAD) settings. Format: "threshold" or "threshold:frame_ms". The threshold (0-100) sets sensitivity for detecting voice activity. The optional frame_ms (16-40) sets frame duration in milliseconds.
    wait_for_user bool | SWMLVar

    When false, AI agent will initialize dialogue after call is setup. When true, agent will wait for the user to speak first.
    wake_prefix str

    Specifies an additional prefix that must be spoken along with the agent's name (ai_name) to wake the agent from a paused state. For example, if ai_name is "computer" and wake_prefix is "hey", the user would need to say "hey computer" to activate the agent.
    eleven_labs_stability float | SWMLVar

    The stability slider determines how stable the voice is and the randomness between each generation. Lowering this slider introduces a broader emotional range for the voice. Deprecated.
    eleven_labs_similarity float | SWMLVar

    The similarity slider dictates how closely the AI should adhere to the original voice when attempting to replicate it. The higher the similarity, the closer the AI will sound to the original voice. Deprecated.

    BedrockParams ¶

    Bases: TypedDict

    Open shape: extra server keys permitted; not validated at runtime.

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    attention_timeout AttentionTimeout | Literal[0] | SWMLVar

    Amount of time, in ms, to wait before prompting the user to respond. Allowed values from 10,000 - 600,000. Set to 0 to disable. Default: 5000 ms.
    hard_stop_time str | SWMLVar

    Specifies the maximum duration fopr the AI Agent to remain active before it exists the session. After the timeout, the AI will stop responding, and will proceed with the next SWML instruction.

    Time Format: - Seconds Format: 30s - Minutes Format: 2m - Hours Format: 1h - Combined Format: 1h45m30s
    inactivity_timeout int | SWMLVar

    Amount of time, in ms, to wait before exiting the app due to inactivity. Allowed values from 10,000 - 3,600,000. Default: 600000 ms (10 minutes).
    video_listening_file str

    URL of a video file to play when AI is listening to the user speak. Only works for calls that support video.
    video_idle_file str

    URL of a video file to play when AI is idle. Only works for calls that support video.
    video_talking_file str

    URL of a video file to play when AI is talking. Only works for calls that support video.
    hard_stop_prompt str

    A final prompt that is fed into the AI when the hard_stop_time is reached.

    LanguagesWithSoloFillers ¶

    Bases: TypedDict

    Open shape: extra server keys permitted; not validated at runtime.

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    name str

    Name of the language (e.g., 'French', 'English'). This value is used in the system prompt to instruct the LLM what language is being spoken.
    code str

    The language code for ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) purposes. By default, SignalWire uses Deepgram's Nova-3 STT engine, so this value should match a code from Deepgram's Nova-3 language codes. If a different STT model was selected using the openai_asr_engine parameter, you must select a code supported by that engine.
    voice str

    Voice to use for the language. String format: <engine id>.<voice id>. Select engine from gcloud, polly, elevenlabs, cartesia, or deepgram. For example, gcloud.fr-FR-Neural2-B.
    model str

    The model to use for the specified TTS engine. For example, 'arcana'.
    emotion Literal['auto']

    Enables emotion detection for the set TTS engine. This allows the AI to express emotions when speaking. A global emotion or specific emotions for certain topics can be set within the prompt of the AI. IMPORTANT: Only works with Cartesia TTS engine.
    speed Literal['auto']

    The speed to use for the specified TTS engine. This allows the AI to speak at a different speed at different points in the conversation. The speed behavior can be defined in the prompt of the AI. IMPORTANT: Only works with Cartesia TTS engine.
    engine str

    The engine to use for the language. For example, 'elevenlabs'. Deprecated.
    params LanguageParams

    TTS engine-specific parameters for this language.
    fillers list[str]

    An array of strings to be used as fillers in the conversation. This will be used for both speech and function fillers if provided. Deprecated.

    name instance-attribute ¶

    code instance-attribute ¶

    voice instance-attribute ¶

    model instance-attribute ¶

    emotion instance-attribute ¶

    speed instance-attribute ¶

    engine instance-attribute ¶

    params instance-attribute ¶

    fillers instance-attribute ¶

    AIPostPromptText ¶

    Bases: TypedDict

    Open shape: extra server keys permitted; not validated at runtime.

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    max_tokens int

    Limits the amount of tokens that the AI agent may generate when creating its response
    temperature float | SWMLVar

    Randomness setting. Float value between 0.0 and 1.5. Closer to 0 will make the output less random. Default: 1.0.
    top_p float | SWMLVar

    Randomness setting. Alternative to temperature. Float value between 0.0 and 1.0. Closer to 0 will make the output less random. Default: 1.0.
    confidence float | SWMLVar

    Threshold to fire a speech-detect event at the end of the utterance. Float value between 0.0 and 1.0. Decreasing this value will reduce the pause after the user speaks, but may introduce false positives. Default: 0.6.
    presence_penalty float | SWMLVar

    Aversion to staying on topic. Float value between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values increase the model's likelihood to talk about new topics. Default: 0.
    frequency_penalty float | SWMLVar

    Aversion to repeating lines. Float value between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values decrease the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim. Default: 0.
    text str

    The instructions to send to the agent.

    max_tokens instance-attribute ¶

    temperature instance-attribute ¶

    top_p instance-attribute ¶

    confidence instance-attribute ¶

    presence_penalty instance-attribute ¶

    frequency_penalty instance-attribute ¶

    text instance-attribute ¶

All subsequent items MUST be PomSection (with required title and body).

    OmitPropertiesBedrockPromptPomOmittedPromptProps ¶

    Bases: TypedDict

    The template for omitting properties.

    Open shape: extra server keys are permitted and partial payloads are valid; not validated at runtime (a TypedDict is a plain dict).

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    max_tokens int

    Limits the amount of tokens that the AI agent may generate when creating its response
    temperature float | SWMLVar

    Randomness setting. Float value between 0.0 and 1.5. Closer to 0 will make the output less random. Default: 1.0.
    top_p float | SWMLVar

    Randomness setting. Alternative to temperature. Float value between 0.0 and 1.0. Closer to 0 will make the output less random. Default: 1.0.
    confidence float | SWMLVar

    Threshold to fire a speech-detect event at the end of the utterance. Float value between 0.0 and 1.0. Decreasing this value will reduce the pause after the user speaks, but may introduce false positives. Default: 0.6.
    presence_penalty float | SWMLVar

    Aversion to staying on topic. Float value between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values increase the model's likelihood to talk about new topics. Default: 0.
    frequency_penalty float | SWMLVar

    Aversion to repeating lines. Float value between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values decrease the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim. Default: 0.
    pom list[POM]

    The instructions to send to the agent.

    voice_id instance-attribute ¶

    UserSWAIGFunction ¶

    Bases: TypedDict

    Open shape: extra server keys permitted; not validated at runtime.

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    description str

    A description of the context and purpose of the function, to explain to the agent when to use it.
    purpose str

    The purpose field has been deprecated and is replaced by the description field. A description of the context and purpose of the function, to explain to the agent when to use it. Deprecated.
    parameters FunctionParameters

    A JSON object that defines the expected user input parameters and their validation rules for the function.
    fillers FunctionFillers

    A JSON object defining the fillers that should be played when calling a swaig function. This helps the AI break silence between responses. The filler is played asynchronously during the function call.
    argument FunctionParameters

    The argument field has been deprecated and is replaced by the parameters field. A JSON object defining the input that should be passed to the function. The fields of this object are the following two parameters. Deprecated.
    active bool | SWMLVar

    Whether the function is active. Default: true.
    meta_data dict[str, Any]

    A powerful and flexible environmental variable which can accept arbitrary data that is set initially in the SWML script or from the SWML set_meta_data action. This data can be referenced locally to the function. All contained information can be accessed and expanded within the prompt - for example, by using a template string. Default is not set.
    meta_data_token str

    Scoping token for meta_data. If not supplied, metadata will be scoped to function's web_hook_url. Default is set by SignalWire.
    data_map DataMap

    An object that processes function inputs and executes operations through expressions, webhooks, or direct output. Properties are evaluated in strict priority order: 1. expressions 2. webhooks 3. output

    Evaluation stops at the first property that returns a valid output result, similar to a return statement in a function. Any subsequent properties are ignored when a valid output is returned. If a valid output is not returned from any of the properties, a generic error message is returned.
    skip_fillers bool | SWMLVar

    Skips the top-level fillers specified in ai.languages (which includes speech_fillers and function_fillers). When set to true, only function-specific fillers defined directly on SWAIG.functions.fillers will play. Default: false.
    web_hook_url str

    Function-specific URL to send status callbacks and reports to. Takes precedence over a default setting. Authentication can also be set in the url in the format of username:password@url.
    wait_file str

    A file to play while the function is running. wait_file_loops can specify the amount of times that files should continously play. Default is not set.
    wait_file_loops int | str

    The number of times to loop playing the file. Default is not set.
    wait_for_fillers bool | SWMLVar

    Whether to wait for fillers to finish playing before continuing with the function. Default: false.
    function str

    A unique name for the function. This can be any user-defined string or can reference a reserved function. Reserved functions are SignalWire functions that will be executed at certain points in the conversation.

    Bases: TypedDict

    Attributes:

    The name of the step. The name must be unique within the context. The name is used for referencing the step in the context.
    step_criteria str

    The criteria that must be met for the AI to proceed to the next step. The criteria is an instruction given to the AI. It's highly recommended you create a custom criteria for the step to get the intended behavior.
    functions list[str]

    An array of strings, where each string is the name of a SWAIG.function that can be executed from this step.
    valid_contexts list[str]

    An array of context names that the AI can transition to from this step. This must be a valid contexts.name that is present in your contexts object.
    skip_user_turn bool | SWMLVar

    A boolean value, if set to true, will skip the user's turn to respond in the conversation and proceed to the next step. Default: false.
    end bool

    A boolean value that determines if the step is the last in the context. If true, the context ends after this step. Cannot be used along with the valid_steps parameter. Default: false.
    valid_steps list[str]

    An array of valid steps that the conversation can proceed to from this step. If the array is empty, or the valid_steps key is not present, the conversation will proceed to the next step in the context.
    pom list[POM]

    An array of objects that define the POM for the step. POM is the Post-Prompt Object Model, which is used to define the flow of the conversation.

    ConnectConfig ¶

    Bases: TypedDict

    Dial a SIP URI or phone number.

    Open shape: extra server keys are permitted and partial payloads are valid; not validated at runtime (a TypedDict is a plain dict).

    Wire-only keys (not valid Python identifiers, so they are listed here rather than as attributes; read them with item access): - from (str): The caller ID to use when dialing the number.

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    headers list[ConnectHeaders]

    Custom SIP headers to add to INVITE. It Has no effect on calls to phone numbers.
    codecs str

    Comma-separated string of codecs to offer. It has no effect on calls to phone numbers. Based on SignalWire settings.
    webrtc_media bool | SWMLVar

    If true, WebRTC media is offered to the SIP endpoint. It has no effect on calls to phone numbers. Default is false.
    session_timeout int | SWMLVar

    Time, in seconds, to set the SIP Session-Expires header in INVITE. Must be a positive, non-zero number. It has no effect on calls to phone numbers. Based on SignalWire settings.
    ringback list[str] | RingbackConfig

    Ringback to play while the far end rings: a legacy array of URIs, or a RingbackConfig object.
    result ConnectSwitch | list[CondParams]

    Action to take based on the result of the call. This will run once the peer leg of the call has ended. Will use the switch method when the return_value is an object, and will use the cond method when the return_value is an array.
    timeout int | SWMLVar

    Time, in seconds, to wait for the call to be answered. Default is 60 seconds.
    max_duration int | SWMLVar

    Maximum duration, in seconds, allowed for the call. Default is 14400 seconds.
    answer_on_bridge bool | SWMLVar

    Delay answer until the B-leg answers. Default is false.
    confirm str | list[ValidConfirmMethods]

    Confirmation to execute when the call is connected. Can be either: - A URL (string) that returns a SWML document - An array of SWML methods to execute inline
    confirm_timeout int | SWMLVar

    The amount of time, in seconds, to wait for the confirm URL to return a response
    username str

    SIP username to use for authentication when dialing a SIP URI. Has no effect on calls to phone numbers.
    password str

    SIP password to use for authentication when dialing a SIP URI. Has no effect on calls to phone numbers.
    encryption Literal['mandatory'] | Literal['optional'] | Literal['forbidden']

    Encryption setting to use. Possible values: mandatory, optional, forbidden
    call_state_url str

    Webhook URL to send call status change notifications to. Authentication can also be set in the URL in the format of username:password@url.
    transfer_after_bridge str | SWMLVar

    SWML to execute after the bridge completes. This defines what should happen after the call is connected and the bridge ends. Can be either: - A URL (http or https) that returns a SWML document - An inline SWML document (as a JSON string)

    Note: This parameter is REQUIRED when connecting to a queue (when to starts with "queue:")
    call_state_events list[CallStatus]

    An array of call state event names to be notified about. Allowed event names are: - created - ringing - answered - ended
    to str

    Destination to dial. Can be: - Phone number in E.164 format (e.g., "+15552345678") - SIP URI (e.g., "sip:alice@example.com") - Call Fabric Resource address (e.g., "/public/test_room") - Queue (e.g., "queue:support")
    parallel list[ConnectDeviceSingle]

    Array of destinations to dial simultaneously.
    serial_parallel list[list[ConnectDeviceSingle]]

    Array of arrays. Inner arrays contain destinations to dial simultaneously. Outer array attempts each parallel group in order.

    PromptConfig ¶

    Bases: TypedDict

    Play a prompt and wait for input.

    The input can be received either as digits from the keypad, or from speech, or both depending on what parameters are set. By default, only digit input is enabled. To enable speech input, set at least one speech parameter. To enable both digit and speech input, set at least one parameter for each.

    Open shape: extra server keys are permitted and partial payloads are valid; not validated at runtime (a TypedDict is a plain dict).

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    play play_url | list[play_url] | SWMLVar | list[SWMLVar]

    URL or array of URLs to play. Allowed URLs are: http:// or https:// - audio file to GET ring:[duration:]<country code> - ring tone to play. For example: ring:us to play single ring or ring:20.0:us to play ring for 20 seconds. say:<text to speak> - Sentence to say silence: <duration> - seconds of silence to play
    volume float

    Volume level for the audio file. Default is 0. Valid range is -40 to 40.
    say_voice str

    The voice to use for the text to speech.
    say_language str

    The language to use for the text to speech.
    say_gender Literal['male', 'female']

    The gender to use for the text to speech.
    max_digits int | SWMLVar

    Number of digits to collect. Default is 1.
    terminators str

    Digits that terminate digit collection. Default is not set.
    digit_timeout float | SWMLVar

    Time in seconds to wait for next digit. Default is 5.0 seconds.
    initial_timeout float | SWMLVar

    Time in seconds to wait for start of input. Default is 5.0 seconds.
    speech_timeout float | SWMLVar

    Max time in seconds to wait for speech result.
    speech_end_timeout float | SWMLVar

    Time in seconds to wait for end of speech utterance.
    speech_language str

    Language to detect speech in.
    speech_hints list[str] | list[SWMLVar]

    Expected words or phrases to help the speech recognition.
    speech_engine str

    The engine that is selected for speech recognition. The engine must support the specified language. [Deepgram|Google| etc...] Default is not set (SignalWire picks the engine).
    status_url str

    http or https URL to deliver prompt status events

    RecordConfig ¶

    Bases: TypedDict

    Record the call audio in the foreground, pausing further SWML execution until recording ends.

    Use this, for example, to record voicemails. To record calls in the background in a non-blocking fashion, use the record_call method.

    Open shape: extra server keys are permitted and partial payloads are valid; not validated at runtime (a TypedDict is a plain dict).

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    stereo bool | SWMLVar

    If true, record in stereo. Default is false.
    format Literal['wav'] | Literal['mp3'] | Literal['mp4']

    The format to record in. Can be wav, mp3, or mp4. Default is "wav".
    direction Literal['speak'] | Literal['listen']

    Direction of the audio to record: "speak" for what party says, "listen" for what party hears. Default is "speak".
    terminators str

    String of digits that will stop the recording when pressed. Default is "#".
    beep bool | SWMLVar

    Play a beep before recording. Default is false.
    input_sensitivity float | SWMLVar

    How sensitive the recording voice activity detector is to background noise. A larger value is more sensitive. Allowed values from 0.0 to 100.0. Default is 44.0.
    initial_timeout float | SWMLVar

    Time in seconds to wait for the start of speech. Default is 4.0 seconds.
    end_silence_timeout float | SWMLVar

    Time in seconds to wait in silence before ending the recording. Default is 5.0 seconds.
    max_length float | SWMLVar

    Maximum length of the recording in seconds.
    status_url str

    URL to send recording status events to.

    RecordCallConfig ¶

    Bases: TypedDict

    Record call in the background.

    Unlike the record method, the record_call method will start the recording and continue executing the SWML script while allowing the recording to happen in the background. To stop call recordings started with record_call, use the stop_record_call method.

    Open shape: extra server keys are permitted and partial payloads are valid; not validated at runtime (a TypedDict is a plain dict).

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    control_id str

    Identifier for this recording, to use with stop_call_record.
    stereo bool | SWMLVar

    If true, record in stereo. Default is false.
    format Literal['wav'] | Literal['mp3'] | Literal['mp4']

    The format to record in. It can be wav, mp3, or mp4. Default is "wav".
    direction Literal['speak'] | Literal['listen'] | Literal['both']

    Direction of the audio to record: "speak" for what party says, "listen" for what party hears, "both" for what the party hears and says. Default is "both".
    terminators str

    String of digits that will stop the recording when pressed. Default is "" (empty).
    beep bool | SWMLVar

    Play a beep before recording. Default is false.
    input_sensitivity float | SWMLVar

    How sensitive the recording voice activity detector is to background noise. A larger value is more sensitive. Allowed values from 0.0 to 100.0. Default is 44.0.
    initial_timeout float | SWMLVar

    Time in seconds to wait for the start of speech. Default is 0.0 seconds.
    end_silence_timeout float | SWMLVar

    Time in seconds to wait in silence before ending the recording. Default is 0.0 seconds.
    max_length float | SWMLVar

    Maximum length of the recording in seconds.
    status_url str

    http or https URL to deliver record_call status events

    Object containing HTTP headers to set. Valid header values are Accept, Authorization, Content-Type, Range, and custom X- headers.
    body str | dict[str, Any]

    Request body. Content-Type header should be explicitly set, but if not set, the most likely type will be set based on the first non-whitespace character.

    Maximum time in seconds to wait for a response. Default is 0 (no timeout).
    connect_timeout float | SWMLVar

    Maximum time in seconds to wait for a connection. Default is 0 (no timeout).

Authentication can also be set in the URL in the format of username:password@url. - An inline SWML document (as a JSON string)

    PayConfig ¶

    Bases: TypedDict

    Enables secure payment processing during voice calls.

    When implemented, it manages the entire payment flow including data collection, validation, and processing through your configured payment gateway.

    Open shape: extra server keys are permitted and partial payloads are valid; not validated at runtime (a TypedDict is a plain dict).

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    payment_connector_url str

    The URL to make POST requests with all the gathered payment details. This URL is used to process the final payment transaction and return the results through the response.

    Visit https://signalwire.com/docs/swml/methods/pay/payment_connector_url for more important information.
    charge_amount str

    The amount to charge against payment method passed in the request. Float value with no currency prefix passed as string.
    currency str

    Uses the ISO 4217 currency code of the charge amount.
    description str

    Custom description of the payment provided in the request.
    input Literal['dtmf']

    The method of how to collect the payment details. Currently only dtmf mode is supported.
    language str

    Language to use for prompts being played to the caller by the pay method.
    max_attempts int | SWMLVar

    Number of times the pay method will retry to collect payment details.
    min_postal_code_length int | SWMLVar

    The minimum length of the postal code the user must enter.
    parameters list[PayParameters]

    Array of parameter objects to pass to your payment processor. The parameters are user-defined key-value pairs.
    payment_method Literal['credit-card']

    Indicates the payment method which is going to be used in this payment request. Currently only credit-card is supported.
    postal_code bool | str

    Takes true, false or real postalcode (if it's known beforehand) to let pay method know whether to prompt for postal code. Default is true.
    prompts list[PayPrompts]

    Array of prompt objects for customizing the audio prompts during different stages of the payment process.
    security_code bool | SWMLVar

    Takes true or false to let pay method know whether to prompt for security code.
    status_url str

    The URL to send requests for each status change during the payment process.

    See https://signalwire.com/docs/swml/methods/pay#status_url_request_body for more important information.
    timeout int | SWMLVar

    Limit in seconds that pay method waits for the caller to press another digit before moving on to validate the digits captured.
    token_type Literal['one-time'] | Literal['reusable']

    Whether the payment is a one off payment or re-occurring.

    Allowed values: - one-time - reusable
    valid_card_types str

    List of payment cards allowed to use in the requested payment process separated by space.

    Allowed values: - visa - mastercard - amex - maestro - discover - jcb - diners-club
    voice str

    Text-to-speech voice to use. Please refer to https://signalwire.com/docs/voice/getting-started/voice-and-languages for more information.

    DetectMachineConfig ¶

    Bases: TypedDict

    A detection method that combines AMD (Answering Machine Detection) and fax detection.

    Detect whether the user on the other end of the call is a machine (fax, voicemail, etc.) or a human. The detection result(s) will be sent to the specified status_url as a POST request and will also be saved in the detect_result variable.

    Open shape: extra server keys are permitted and partial payloads are valid; not validated at runtime (a TypedDict is a plain dict).

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    detect_message_end bool | SWMLVar

    If true, stops detection on beep / end of voicemail greeting. Default false.
    detectors str

    Comma-separated string of detectors to enable. Valid values: amd, fax.
    end_silence_timeout float | SWMLVar

    How long to wait for voice to finish. Default 1.0.
    initial_timeout float | SWMLVar

    How long to wait for initial voice before giving up. Default 4.5.
    machine_ready_timeout float | SWMLVar

    How long to wait for voice to finish before firing READY event. Default is end_silence_timeout.
    machine_voice_threshold float | SWMLVar

    The number of seconds of ongoing voice activity required to classify as MACHINE. Default 1.25.
    machine_words_threshold int | SWMLVar

    The minimum number of words that must be detected in a single utterance before classifying the call as MACHINE. Default 6.
    status_url str

    The http(s) URL to deliver detector events to.
    timeout float | SWMLVar

    The max time to run detector. Default 30.0 seconds.
    tone Literal['CED'] | Literal['CNG']

    The tone to detect, will only receive remote side tone. Default CED.
    wait bool | SWMLVar

    If false, the detector will run asynchronously and status_url must be set. If true, the detector will wait for detection to complete before moving to the next SWML instruction. Default is true.

    detect_message_end instance-attribute ¶

    detectors instance-attribute ¶

    end_silence_timeout instance-attribute ¶

    initial_timeout instance-attribute ¶

    machine_ready_timeout instance-attribute ¶

    machine_voice_threshold instance-attribute ¶

    machine_words_threshold instance-attribute ¶

    status_url instance-attribute ¶

    timeout instance-attribute ¶

    tone instance-attribute ¶

    wait instance-attribute ¶
